//react-unity-webgl: Deliberately held at 9.x. This is a types-only dependency: src/webgl-compat reimplements react-unity-webgl's API so app code written against it runs inside a ReactUnity WebGL build, and it re-exports that package's types as part of its own public surface. Version 10 reshaped them -- dropped the deprecated aliases the shim provides (send, setFullscreen, quitUnityInstance), renamed UnityContextHook to UnityContext, added a required getMetricsInfo, removed the WebGLContextAttributes type, and changed UnityProvider to spread the config instead of carrying it. Following it is a compatibility decision for @reactunity/renderer/webgl-compat, and would break consumers still on 9 -- not a version bump. Left for a change that can be tested against a real WebGL build.
